# PHP Ledger

> PHP Ledger is open-source, self-hosted double-entry accounting software with core invoices, bills and payments, optional purchasing and inventory, and a manually configured tax engine. Built on PHP 8.2+ with MySQL 8.4 or MariaDB 10.4+, 1.1.3 is the current release: unzip it into any web folder, open it, and the browser installer starts; updates are publisher-signed. 1.0.0 was the first stable release; independent accounting and security review remain post-release commitments.

Current stable release: 1.1.3. PHP 8.2+ (8.3 recommended), MySQL 8.4 or MariaDB 10.4+ (InnoDB), HTTPS; upload the phpledger folder and open it in a browser, no terminal required for setup; PHP zip extension for automatic updates.

New project-owned code: AGPL-3.0-or-later; commercial licensing available. Pre-adoption 0.1.0 through 0.1.5 previews retain MIT; dependencies and archived code keep their own terms.

## Implemented scope

- 0.6.0 workspace with a focused Home, sidebar and company switcher, search/jump, quick-create actions, URL-based list filters and 25/50/100-row pagination.
- One-line-first invoice and bill editors, exact totals and posting previews; atomic allocation of one settlement across multiple open items; cost-of-sales classification, gross profit and P&L period presets.
- Company setup in ten functional currencies, one immutable functional currency per book; account management and audit history.
- Receipt, expense and general-journal drafts, balanced posting, linked dated reversals and correction mechanics preserving document identity.
- Account ledgers, trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, core CSV exports, bank CSV reconciliation, period controls and reviewed opening-cutover workflow.
- Core AR/AP: shared customer/vendor parties, invoices, bills, partial/final allocated payments, linked credits, historical ageing and control-account reconciliation. Owners can hide navigation without disabling services.
- Optional Purchasing: purchase orders, partial goods receipts, later matched AP bills, reviewed variances, returns and received-but-unbilled reconciliation.
- Optional Inventory: shared products, one stock location, moving weighted-average cost, stock invoice issues, source-linked returns, counts and reviewed value adjustments.
- Core manual tax codes and dated rates, input/output account mappings, inclusive/exclusive price entry and frozen document snapshots; no automatic country rules.
- Reviewed opening party/product conversion ties supported existing balances to shared ledgers without reposting the opening journal.
- Cash POS with a sample catalogue and printable receipt; twelve demo choices: an Accounting starter playground plus eleven multi-year teaching histories. Cash POS does not issue shared stock.
- Scoped, revocable read API and MCP connections, with the published client compatibility matrix defining tested clients.
- Exact currency snapshots with manual document and settlement rates, realised FX settlement mechanics, same-identity corrections and an unconfigured retryable event outbox.
- WordPress-style installation: upload the phpledger folder into any web folder and open it; the browser installer checks the host and database, runs the migration chain, creates the first account with a chosen username and optional logo, and starts business onboarding, without Composer, Node or a terminal.
- Publisher-signed automatic updates from an independent maintenance interface, with automatic matched code/configuration/key/database backup before applying a release and automatic restoration if a migration or mutation fails.

## Outside the current workflows

- Advances, unapplied credits, overpayments and cash refunds; Quotes remains a separate future plugin.
- Multiple stock locations, batches, serials, expiry, landed cost, letters of credit, manufacturing and integration of cash POS with shared stock.
- Country tax rules, withholding, compound or nonrecoverable tax policies, statutory filing and professionally accepted reporting packages.
- Automated rate providers, outgoing payments from foreign-currency bank accounts, period-end revaluation and group consolidation.
- Vetting enforcement, vendor bank change control and outbound connectors.
- Financial write API/MCP, card processing, bank feeds, offline use, document scanning and detailed historical imports. New country account catalogues and advanced vertical workflows remain outside this release.
- Mobile refinement and dark mode; complete visual/accessibility acceptance, consistent field-level validation recovery and full nested report/source/action return behavior remain unfinished.
- Independent accounting review, independent security review, supervised pilots with a real month-end close, unfamiliar-operator installation observation and restricted shared-host recovery certification have not happened; these are post-release commitments, not completed acceptance.
